messages.subject: tlenght argument in unmarkedFrameDS
parts:
Hello,

I am trying to organize my data to run a distsamp analysis in unmarked.
I'm using unmarkedFrameDS, but I'm not able to set the tlength term, since I have some transects showing a different length from the general length of 2000m. 
Moreover, how should I consider those transects walked twice? should I just double their length?

Thank you very much for your help,
Nathalie

messages.author: 4a15de51da4445ae
messages.subject: Re: [unmarked] tlenght argument in unmarkedFrameDS
parts:
hi Nathalie,
 I don't understand "I'm not able to set the tlength" concern -- I believe this argument can be a vector having a different value for each transect.

 For transects surveyed twice or more times you have 3 options: as you say, double their length;  or treat them as completely new transects (add them to the data set twice) -- good if you want to model time effects -- or use the gdistsamp function which allows for a type of open population in which N changes from one sample to the next.

regards
andy
